lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Contacts closing fast. It's an ambush, General!

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Guarding freighters now, Arden? How far you fell.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Power down your guns and surrender, and I will forgive everything. You have my word.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Good. Weapons cold. My escort will bring you in, Arden.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Did you truly believe I would forgive a traitor? You always were too trusting.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Guards, take the General. The execution is at dawn.

lines.speaker: isolde
lines.text: Then you will die out here with your freighters. Mauls, finish them.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Convoy's through, every ship of it. You flew like you meant it, General.

lines.speaker: tarek
lines.text: Get some rest. Tomorrow we break her blockade, and I want you on my wing when we do.
